src_py: lín jū jiā de hái zi wǔ suì
task: Say the child has just turned five.
zh: 邻居家的孩子五岁了。
py: lín jū jiā de hái zi wǔ suì le
en: The neighbours' child is five now.
why: An age that has just been reached is a change of state, so 了 goes at the end.

q: 我吃___饭就去楼下找你。
zh: 我吃了饭就去楼下找你。
py: wǒ chī le fàn jiù qù lóu xià zhǎo nǐ
en: I'll come downstairs to find you as soon as I've eaten.
why: In 'A, then B', 了 goes right after the first verb 吃, even for a future plan. 着 would mean eating and going at the same time.

q: 我们的小区不太大___，走十分钟就到头了。
zh: 我们的小区不太大，走十分钟就到头了。
py: wǒ men de xiǎo qū bù tài dà zǒu shí fēn zhōng jiù dào tóu le
en: Our neighbourhood isn't very big; you reach the end after a ten-minute walk.
why: 不太 + adjective is a plain description, so no 了. The 太 … 了 pattern needs 太 without 不 and means 'too / so'.

q: 我们在这个小区住___三年了，邻居们都很熟。
zh: 我们在这个小区住了三年了，邻居们都很熟。
py: wǒ men zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le sān nián le lín jū men dōu hěn shú
en: We have lived in this neighbourhood for three years, and we all know our neighbours well.
why: An amount up to now ends in 了, and the verb needs its own 了 before the number: 住了三年了. 过, 着 and 的 cannot count the years.

q: 以前我们住平房的时候，冬天总是烧___煤取暖。
zh: 以前我们住平房的时候，冬天总是烧煤取暖。
py: yǐ qián wǒ men zhù píng fáng de shí hou dōng tiān zǒng shì shāo méi qǔ nuǎn
en: When we lived in a bungalow we always burned coal to keep warm in winter.
why: 总是 in a past habit still takes no 了. 烧了煤 would be one finished burning, and 过 would say it was done once in a lifetime.

q: 他们每天晚上都在小区里散___步。
zh: 他们每天晚上都在小区里散步。
py: tā men měi tiān wǎn shang dōu zài xiǎo qū lǐ sàn bù
en: They go for a walk in the neighbourhood every evening.
why: 每天晚上都 is a routine, so no 了 inside 散步. 散了步 would be a single walk that already happened.

q: 他昨天在楼下等___半个小时。
zh: 他昨天在楼下等了半个小时。
py: tā zuó tiān zài lóu xià děng le bàn ge xiǎo shí
en: He waited downstairs for half an hour yesterday.
why: A finished wait of a stated length (半个小时) in a past frame: 了 after 等. 等着 would present the waiting as still going on.

s: 去年他是了我们的房东。
s_py: qù nián tā shì le wǒ men de fáng dōng
zh: 去年他是我们的房东。
py: qù nián tā shì wǒ men de fáng dōng
en: He was our landlord last year.
why: 是 is not an action that can be completed, and 去年 already marks the time. 是了 is never used for 'was'.

q: 你换___鞋再进屋，地板刚拖过。
zh: 你换了鞋再进屋，地板刚拖过。
py: nǐ huàn le xié zài jìn wū dì bǎn gāng tuō guò
en: Change your shoes before you come in; I've just mopped the floor.
why: 再 sequences two steps, and 了 right after 换 marks the change as done before entering. 换着鞋 would mean changing while walking in.

q: 楼上的邻居经常半夜洗___衣服，吵得我睡不着。
zh: 楼上的邻居经常半夜洗衣服，吵得我睡不着。
py: lóu shàng de lín jū jīng cháng bàn yè xǐ yī fu chǎo de wǒ shuì bu zháo
en: The neighbour upstairs often does laundry in the middle of the night, and the noise keeps me awake.
why: 经常 marks a repeated habit, so 洗衣服 stays bare. 洗了 would turn it into one finished event, which clashes with 经常.

s: 下了课你就来找我吧，我在三楼。
s_py: xià le kè nǐ jiù lái zhǎo wǒ ba wǒ zài sān lóu
zh: 下了课你就来找我吧，我在三楼。
py: xià le kè nǐ jiù lái zhǎo wǒ ba wǒ zài sān lóu
en: Come and find me after class; I'm on the third floor.
why: Correct: 了 right after 下 marks the class as over, and a request about the future is fine with it. 我在三楼 is a state and has no 了.

q: 春节那几天，爸爸因为工作很忙，一直在___公司，没能回家。
zh: 春节那几天，爸爸因为工作很忙，一直在公司，没能回家。
py: chūn jié nà jǐ tiān bà ba yīn wèi gōng zuò hěn máng yī zhí zài gōng sī méi néng huí jiā
en: During the Spring Festival days Dad was busy with work and stayed at the office, unable to come home.
why: 在 + place says where he was, a state, so no 了 after 在. 一直 also shows no single finished event.

q: 我以前在老小区住了三年___，后来才搬来这里。
zh: 我以前在老小区住了三年，后来才搬来这里。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài lǎo xiǎo qū zhù le sān nián hòu lái cái bān lái zhè lǐ
en: I lived in the old neighbourhood for three years before I moved here.
why: 以前 and 后来 close the three years off, so only the verb 了 is used. A final 了 would say the three years run up to now, which 后来才搬来这里 denies.

q: 我儿子下个月就要七岁___。
zh: 我儿子下个月就要七岁了。
py: wǒ ér zi xià ge yuè jiù yào qī suì le
en: My son will be seven next month.
why: 就要 … 了 frames a change that is about to happen, so 了 closes the sentence. 的, 着 and 过 cannot end a 就要 sentence.

q: 你下___班再去超市吧，现在商店里人很多。
zh: 你下了班再去超市吧，现在商店里人很多。
py: nǐ xià le bān zài qù chāo shì ba xiàn zài shāng diàn lǐ rén hěn duō
en: Go to the supermarket after work; the shop is crowded right now.
why: 再 links two steps, and 了 after 下 marks work as finished first. 着, 的 and 到 cannot mean 'after finishing work'.

src_py: wǒ xiǎng qù kàn yān huā
task: Say you no longer want to go and see the fireworks.
zh: 我不想去看烟花了。
py: wǒ bù xiǎng qù kàn yān huā le
en: I don't want to go and see the fireworks any more.
why: 不 + verb + 了 means 'no longer'; 了 sits at the very end, after the object.

q: 元宵节快到___，街上挂满了灯笼。
zh: 元宵节快到了，街上挂满了灯笼。
py: yuán xiāo jié kuài dào le jiē shàng guà mǎn le dēng long
en: The Lantern Festival is almost here, and the street is full of lanterns.
why: 快 … 了 means 'about to', so 了 must end 快到. 着, 的 and 过 do not combine with 快.

zh: 奶奶包了一上午饺子了。
py: nǎi nai bāo le yī shàng wǔ jiǎo zi le
en: Grandma has been making dumplings all morning.
why: 了 after 包 counts the morning and the final 了 says she is still at it. A single 了 would sound finished.

s: 下雨了，我们不去了公园。
s_py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù qù le gōng yuán
zh: 下雨了，我们不去公园了。
py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù qù gōng yuán le
en: It's raining, so we're not going to the park any more.
why: In 不 + verb + 了 the 了 goes at the end of the sentence, after the object. 不去了 followed by the object breaks the pattern.

src_py: bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu niú nǎi
task: Say there is no milk left.
zh: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。
py: bīng xiāng lǐ méi yǒu niú nǎi le
en: There's no milk left in the fridge.
why: 没有 + noun + 了 means 'none left'; the 了 is final, and 有 is negated with 没, not 不.

q: 本来想去公园，可是天气太冷了，我们不去___。
zh: 本来想去公园，可是天气太冷了，我们不去了。
py: běn lái xiǎng qù gōng yuán kě shì tiān qì tài lěng le wǒ men bù qù le
en: We wanted to go to the park, but it is too cold, so we're not going after all.
why: 本来 … 可是 shows a changed plan, so 不去 needs a final 了 ('not going after all'). 着, 过 and 的 cannot end a decision.

zh: 这间厨房太小了。
py: zhè jiān chú fáng tài xiǎo le
en: This kitchen is too small.
why: 太 + adjective is a complete remark that ends with 了.

s: 我昨天觉得了这个房间太小。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān jué de le zhè ge fáng jiān tài xiǎo
zh: 我昨天觉得这个房间太小。
py: wǒ zuó tiān jué de zhè ge fáng jiān tài xiǎo
en: I thought this room was too small yesterday.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state of mind, and never takes 了 right after it. 昨天 already gives the time.

q: 我们等电梯等___二十分钟___，还是没人来修。
zh: 我们等电梯等了二十分钟了，还是没人来修。
py: wǒ men děng diàn tī děng le èr shí fēn zhōng le hái shi méi rén lái xiū
en: We have been waiting for the lift for twenty minutes, and still nobody has come to fix it.
why: 还是没人来修 shows the wait is still going on, so the amount takes two 了: after 等 and at the end. 着 cannot count twenty minutes.

q: 我已经不住在老小区___，现在住在城东。
zh: 我已经不住在老小区了，现在住在城东。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bù zhù zài lǎo xiǎo qū le xiàn zài zhù zài chéng dōng
en: I don't live in the old neighbourhood any more; I live in the east of the city now.
why: 已经不 … 了 means 'no longer'. 着, 吗 and 呢 cannot close that change of situation.

q: 为了过年，我们把厨房打扫___两遍。
zh: 为了过年，我们把厨房打扫了两遍。
py: wèi le guò nián wǒ men bǎ chú fáng dǎ sǎo le liǎng biàn
en: For the New Year we cleaned the kitchen twice.
why: A finished action with a counted frequency (两遍): 了 right after the verb 打扫, even in a 把 sentence. 着, 的 and 地 cannot mark completion.

s: 爷爷以前每天早上都在院子里打了太极拳。
s_py: yé ye yǐ qián měi tiān zǎo shang dōu zài yuàn zi lǐ dǎ le tài jí quán
zh: 爷爷以前每天早上都在院子里打太极拳。
py: yé ye yǐ qián měi tiān zǎo shang dōu zài yuàn zi lǐ dǎ tài jí quán
en: Grandpa used to practise tai chi in the courtyard every morning.
why: 每天早上都 makes this a past habit, and habits take no 了, even in the past. 打了太极拳 would be one finished session.

s: 这套房子又大又干净，价格也不太贵。
s_py: zhè tào fáng zi yòu dà yòu gān jìng jià gé yě bù tài guì
zh: 这套房子又大又干净，价格也不太贵。
py: zhè tào fáng zi yòu dà yòu gān jìng jià gé yě bù tài guì
en: This flat is big and clean, and the price isn't too high either.
why: Correct: 不太 + adjective is a plain description, so no 了 even though 太 is there. 了 only follows a 太 remark without 不.

s: 你搬了家就给我发个地址吧。
s_py: nǐ bān le jiā jiù gěi wǒ fā ge dì zhǐ ba
zh: 你搬了家就给我发个地址吧。
py: nǐ bān le jiā jiù gěi wǒ fā ge dì zhǐ ba
en: Send me the address once you've moved.
why: Correct: 了 after the first verb means 'once that is done', so it works in a future request even though nothing has happened yet.

q: 昨天晚上我在___家看春节晚会。
zh: 昨天晚上我在家看春节晚会。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ zài jiā kàn chūn jié wǎn huì
en: Last night I watched the Spring Festival Gala at home.
why: 在 + place only says where I was; 在了家 is never said. The time word 昨天晚上 already makes it past.

s: 春节快到了，超市里人越来越多。
s_py: chūn jié kuài dào le chāo shì lǐ rén yuè lái yuè duō
zh: 春节快到了，超市里人越来越多。
py: chūn jié kuài dào le chāo shì lǐ rén yuè lái yuè duō
en: Spring Festival is almost here, and the supermarket gets more and more crowded.
why: Correct: 快 … 了 means 'about to', and 了 closes 快到. 越来越多 is a plain description with no 了.

q: 房东上个月没有给我们退___押金。
zh: 房东上个月没有给我们退押金。
py: fáng dōng shàng ge yuè méi yǒu gěi wǒ men tuì yā jīn
en: The landlord didn't return our deposit last month.
why: 没有 negates the past event outright, so 退 stays bare. 退了 would claim the deposit was returned.

s: 他搬走以后，对门就没有人住了。
s_py: tā bān zǒu yǐ hòu duì mén jiù méi yǒu rén zhù le
zh: 他搬走以后，对门就没有人住了。
py: tā bān zǒu yǐ hòu duì mén jiù méi yǒu rén zhù le
en: After he moved out, nobody lives in the flat opposite any more.
why: Correct: 没有 + person + verb + 了 means 'none any more'. This is the change-of-state 了, so it is fine after 没有.

q: 去年春节，我们一家人在老家住___五天，初六才回来。
zh: 去年春节，我们一家人在老家住了五天，初六才回来。
py: qù nián chūn jié wǒ men yī jiā rén zài lǎo jiā zhù le wǔ tiān chū liù cái huí lái
en: Last Spring Festival our family stayed at the old family home for five days and only came back on the sixth.
why: 去年 closes the stay off, so one 了 after 住 gives the finished five days. 着 and 的 cannot mark a completed stay.

q: 我们的房东以前是___中学老师。
zh: 我们的房东以前是中学老师。
py: wǒ men de fáng dōng yǐ qián shì zhōng xué lǎo shī
en: Our landlord used to be a secondary-school teacher.
why: 是 is a state, not an action, and 以前 already shows the past. 是了 is never used for 'was', and 是着 does not exist.

src: 他先到了家，然后给我打了电话。
src_py: tā xiān dào le jiā rán hòu gěi wǒ dǎ le diàn huà
task: Combine into one sentence with 就.
zh: 他到了家就给我打电话了。
py: tā dào le jiā jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
en: As soon as he got home he called me.
why: A past sequence with 就 takes 了 after the first verb 到 and a closing 了 at the end; 打电话 needs no 了 of its own.

src_py: fáng dōng yǐ jīng xiū hǎo le chuāng hu
task: Say the landlord hasn't fixed the window yet.
zh: 房东还没修好窗户。
py: fáng dōng hái méi xiū hǎo chuāng hu
en: The landlord hasn't fixed the window yet.
why: 还没 + verb reports that the action has not happened yet, so the 了 of the source disappears.

q: 你太客气___，我只是帮了一点小忙。
zh: 你太客气了，我只是帮了一点小忙。
py: nǐ tài kè qi le wǒ zhǐ shì bāng le yī diǎn xiǎo máng
en: You're too kind; I only helped a little.
why: 你太客气 is a 太 remark, so 了 ends it. 着 and 过 do not fit an adjective, and 呢 would not complete the 太 pattern.

zh: 他昨天下了班就回家了。
py: tā zuó tiān xià le bān jiù huí jiā le
en: Yesterday he went straight home after work.
why: 了 comes right after the first verb 下 and a final 了 closes the past sequence; 昨天 may precede or follow the subject.

q: 刚搬来的时候屋子很冷，现在暖和___。
zh: 刚搬来的时候屋子很冷，现在暖和了。
py: gāng bān lái de shí hou wū zi hěn lěng xiàn zài nuǎn huo le
en: When we first moved in the house was cold; now it is warm.
why: The contrast with 刚搬来的时候 makes this a change of state, so the sentence ends in 了. 着, 的 and 过 cannot report that it has become warm.

s: 她已经洗三个小时了衣服。
s_py: tā yǐ jīng xǐ sān ge xiǎo shí le yī fu
zh: 她已经洗了三个小时衣服了。
py: tā yǐ jīng xǐ le sān ge xiǎo shí yī fu le
en: She has been washing clothes for three hours.
why: 了 must come directly after the verb 洗, before the duration, and the 'so far' reading adds a final 了. Placing 了 after 三个小时 is not a Chinese pattern.

q: 放___假我们就回老家过年。
zh: 放了假我们就回老家过年。
py: fàng le jià wǒ men jiù huí lǎo jiā guò nián
en: As soon as the holiday starts we'll go back to our hometown for New Year.
why: 放了假就 … means 'once the holiday has begun', so 了 sits right after 放 even though the plan is in the future. 过 would say the holiday has happened before.

q: 妈妈包饺子包___一下午___，还没包完。
zh: 妈妈包饺子包了一下午了，还没包完。
py: mā ma bāo jiǎo zi bāo le yī xià wǔ le hái méi bāo wán
en: Mum has been making dumplings all afternoon and still hasn't finished.
why: 还没包完 means the work is still going, so 了 after the verb and again at the end. 着 cannot count an afternoon.

q: 小时候每年春节，我们都去乡下看___奶奶。
zh: 小时候每年春节，我们都去乡下看奶奶。
py: xiǎo shí hou měi nián chūn jié wǒ men dōu qù xiāng xia kàn nǎi nai
en: When I was little we visited Grandma in the countryside every Spring Festival.
why: 每年春节 … 都 makes this a yearly routine, even in the past, so 看 takes no 了. 看了奶奶 would describe one visit.

q: 虽然房东催了好几次，可是他们还没有交___这个月的房租。
zh: 虽然房东催了好几次，可是他们还没有交这个月的房租。
py: suī rán fáng dōng cuī le hǎo jǐ cì kě shì tā men hái méi yǒu jiāo zhè ge yuè de fáng zū
en: Although the landlord has chased them several times, they still haven't paid this month's rent.
why: 还没有 + verb: the payment has not happened, so 交 takes no 了 even with a specific object (这个月的房租). 交了 would mean it was paid.

q: 他已经给我们修___三次水管___，今天又来了。
zh: 他已经给我们修了三次水管了，今天又来了。
py: tā yǐ jīng gěi wǒ men xiū le sān cì shuǐ guǎn le jīn tiān yòu lái le
en: He has already fixed our pipes three times, and today he is here again.
why: Three repairs so far, with the count still relevant now: 了 after 修 and again at the end. 着 or 的 after the verb cannot mark a completed repair.

zh: 孩子们放了假就回老家了。
py: hái zi men fàng le jià jiù huí lǎo jiā le
en: As soon as the children's holiday began, they went back to their hometown.
why: In a past sequence 了 follows the first verb 放 and a closing 了 ends the sentence; 就 links the two steps, and the subject may come before or after 放了假.

s: 我现在每天晚上都去散步了，身体好多了。
s_py: wǒ xiàn zài měi tiān wǎn shang dōu qù sàn bù le shēn tǐ hǎo duō le
zh: 我现在每天晚上都去散步了，身体好多了。
py: wǒ xiàn zài měi tiān wǎn shang dōu qù sàn bù le shēn tǐ hǎo duō le
en: I go for a walk every evening now, and I'm much healthier.
why: Correct: 每天 normally blocks 了, but here the habit is new ('now I do it daily'), so the final 了 reports a change, as in 好多了.

q: 过年前，我们贴___四副对联。
zh: 过年前，我们贴了四副对联。
py: guò nián qián wǒ men tiē le sì fù duì lián
en: Before the New Year we put up four couplets.
why: A single completed job with a counted object (四副对联): 了 straight after 贴. 着 would describe how something is stuck up, not the finished act.

zh: 我们上周买了一台新冰箱。
py: wǒ men shàng zhōu mǎi le yī tái xīn bīng xiāng
en: We bought a new fridge last week.
why: 了 stays right after 买 and before the counted 一台新冰箱; 上周 may open the sentence or follow the subject.

q: 那时候我不知道___楼上住着一位老作家。
zh: 那时候我不知道楼上住着一位老作家。
py: nà shí hou wǒ bù zhī dào lóu shàng zhù zhe yī wèi lǎo zuò jiā
en: At that time I didn't know that an old writer lived upstairs.
why: 知道 is a state of knowing, and 那时候 sets it in the past. 不知道了 would mean 'I no longer know', which makes no sense here.

zh: 他已经在这儿住了五年了。
py: tā yǐ jīng zài zhè r zhù le wǔ nián le
en: He has already lived here for five years.
why: Five years up to now takes two 了: after 住 and at the end. 已经 can stand before or after the place phrase.

q: 我们昨天没有贴___对联，因为浆糊用完了。
zh: 我们昨天没有贴对联，因为浆糊用完了。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi yǒu tiē duì lián yīn wèi jiàng hu yòng wán le
en: We didn't put up the couplets yesterday because the paste had run out.
why: 没有 means it did not happen, so 贴 takes no 了. The 了 in 用完了 belongs to a different, finished event.

s: 中秋节那天我们吃月饼了三个。
s_py: zhōng qiū jié nà tiān wǒ men chī yuè bǐng le sān ge
zh: 中秋节那天我们吃了三个月饼。
py: zhōng qiū jié nà tiān wǒ men chī le sān ge yuè bǐng
en: On Mid-Autumn Festival we ate three mooncakes.
why: 了 belongs right after 吃, before the number and the object. It cannot come after the object 月饼.

s: 我们三天没见到楼上的邻居了。
s_py: wǒ men sān tiān méi jiàn dào lóu shàng de lín jū le
zh: 我们三天没见到楼上的邻居了。
py: wǒ men sān tiān méi jiàn dào lóu shàng de lín jū le
en: We haven't seen the neighbour upstairs for three days.
why: Correct: 没 and 了 do meet in 'time span + 没 + verb + 了', a situation that has lasted up to now. It is not a negated completed event.

q: 我们不租这套房子___，租金涨了太多。
zh: 我们不租这套房子了，租金涨了太多。
py: wǒ men bù zū zhè tào fáng zi le zū jīn zhǎng le tài duō
en: We're not renting this flat after all; the rent went up too much.
why: A decision reversed because of new information is 不租 … 了. 着, 的 and 过 cannot mean 'after all'.

q: 端午节我一般都在家包___粽子，不出去玩。
zh: 端午节我一般都在家包粽子，不出去玩。
py: duān wǔ jié wǒ yī bān dōu zài jiā bāo zòng zi bù chū qù wán
en: On the Dragon Boat Festival I usually make zongzi at home instead of going out.
why: 一般都 describes what I normally do, not one finished event, so 包 takes no 了. 包了粽子 would report a single occasion.

q: 他昨天吃___晚饭就出门___。
zh: 他昨天吃了晚饭就出门了。
py: tā zuó tiān chī le wǎn fàn jiù chū mén le
en: Yesterday he went out as soon as he had eaten dinner.
why: A past sequence takes 了 after the first verb and a closing 了 at the end. 着 would mean going out while eating.

q: 小时候我家在一楼，窗外有___一棵大树。
zh: 小时候我家在一楼，窗外有一棵大树。
py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ jiā zài yī lóu chuāng wài yǒu yī kē dà shù
en: When I was little we lived on the ground floor, and there was a big tree outside the window.
why: 有 describes how things were, with no new event. 有了 would say that a tree has appeared, which does not fit 小时候.

src_py: zhè ge yuè de fáng zū hěn guì
zh: 这个月的房租太贵了。
py: zhè ge yuè de fáng zū tài guì le
en: This month's rent is too expensive.
why: 太 + adjective is a complaint or exclamation and ends with 了; 很 takes no 了.

zh: 楼上的邻居上个月没交物业费。
py: lóu shàng de lín jū shàng ge yuè méi jiāo wù yè fèi
en: The neighbour upstairs didn't pay the management fee last month.
why: 没 negates the event, so there is no 了; the time phrase may stand before the subject or after it.

zh: 我们的小区安静多了。
py: wǒ men de xiǎo qū ān jìng duō le
en: Our neighbourhood is much quieter now.
why: 'Adjective + 多了' reports a change and ends in 了; 了 cannot sit before 多.

zh: 那时候我们住在一楼。
py: nà shí hou wǒ men zhù zài yī lóu
en: At that time we lived on the ground floor.
why: 住在 describes a past state, so no 了; the time word may open the sentence or follow the subject.

q: 我给邻居打___一个电话，他没接。
zh: 我给邻居打了一个电话，他没接。
py: wǒ gěi lín jū dǎ le yī ge diàn huà tā méi jiē
en: I made a call to my neighbour, but he didn't pick up.
why: Making one call is a completed act with a counted object: 打了一个电话. 着, 的 and 地 cannot mark that the call has been made.

zh: 爷爷不爬楼梯了。
py: yé ye bù pá lóu tī le
en: Grandpa doesn't climb the stairs any more.
why: 不 + verb + 了 means 'no longer'; 了 closes the sentence after the object.

q: 春节我没回___老家，一直在北京。
zh: 春节我没回老家，一直在北京。
py: chūn jié wǒ méi huí lǎo jiā yī zhí zài běi jīng
en: I didn't go back to my hometown for Spring Festival; I stayed in Beijing all along.
why: 没回 already reports that the trip did not happen, so adding 了 contradicts it.

s: 我知道了，下午我就把钥匙还给你。
s_py: wǒ zhī dào le xià wǔ wǒ jiù bǎ yào shi huán gěi nǐ
zh: 我知道了，下午我就把钥匙还给你。
py: wǒ zhī dào le xià wǔ wǒ jiù bǎ yào shi huán gěi nǐ
en: Got it, I'll give the key back to you this afternoon.
why: Correct: 知道 is usually a state, but 我知道了 means 'now I know / understood', a new situation, so the final 了 is right.

s: 房东昨天来看了一下房子。
s_py: fáng dōng zuó tiān lái kàn le yī xià fáng zi
zh: 房东昨天来看了一下房子。
py: fáng dōng zuó tiān lái kàn le yī xià fáng zi
en: The landlord came to look at the flat yesterday.
why: Correct: 看了一下 is a finished quick look, and 了 follows 看 before 一下 and the object even though 房子 is a plain noun.

zh: 他在阳台上种了三盆花。
py: tā zài yáng tái shàng zhòng le sān pén huā
en: He planted three pots of flowers on the balcony.
why: The place phrase comes before the verb, and 了 goes right after 种, before the counted object 三盆花.

q: 奶奶每天早上都给花浇___水。
zh: 奶奶每天早上都给花浇水。
py: nǎi nai měi tiān zǎo shang dōu gěi huā jiāo shuǐ
en: Grandma waters the flowers every morning.
why: 每天早上都 is a daily routine, so 了 is out. 浇了水 would be one completed watering.

s: 孩子们快放了假。
s_py: hái zi men kuài fàng le jià
zh: 孩子们快放假了。
py: hái zi men kuài fàng jià le
en: The children will be on holiday soon.
why: 快 … 了 wraps the whole event: 了 closes the sentence. Putting 了 after 放 treats the holiday as already begun, which clashes with 快.

q: 这个房间太小___，放不下两张床。
zh: 这个房间太小了，放不下两张床。
py: zhè ge fáng jiān tài xiǎo le fàng bu xià liǎng zhāng chuáng
en: This room is too small; two beds won't fit.
why: A 太 + adjective complaint closes with 了. 的, 吗 and 过 cannot end it.

s: 他们没买了月饼。
s_py: tā men méi mǎi le yuè bǐng
zh: 他们没买月饼。
py: tā men méi mǎi yuè bǐng
en: They didn't buy any mooncakes.
why: 没 already negates the event, so 买 cannot take 了. Delete the 了.

q: 去年我们都很喜欢___这个小区，可是物业太差了。
zh: 去年我们都很喜欢这个小区，可是物业太差了。
py: qù nián wǒ men dōu hěn xǐ huan zhè ge xiǎo qū kě shì wù yè tài chà le
en: Last year we all liked this neighbourhood, but the management was too poor.
why: 喜欢 is a state, so 去年 alone sets it in the past; 喜欢了 is wrong. The 了 in 太差了 belongs to the 太…了 remark.

q: 原来说好春节回老家，后来孩子生病，我们不回去___。
zh: 原来说好春节回老家，后来孩子生病，我们不回去了。
py: yuán lái shuō hǎo chūn jié huí lǎo jiā hòu lái hái zi shēng bìng wǒ men bù huí qù le
en: We had agreed to go home for Spring Festival, but then our child fell ill, so we're not going after all.
why: 后来 shows the plan changed, so 不回去 closes with 了 ('not going after all'). The other options cannot end 不回去.

q: 邻居家的孩子学会弹钢琴___，每天晚上都能听到琴声。
zh: 邻居家的孩子学会弹钢琴了，每天晚上都能听到琴声。
py: lín jū jiā de hái zi xué huì tán gāng qín le měi tiān wǎn shang dōu néng tīng dào qín shēng
en: The neighbours' child has learned the piano, and we can hear it every evening.
why: 学会 … 了 reports a new ability, which explains the music we now hear. 过 would mean he once learned it, and 着 and 的 do not fit 学会.

s: 这些灯笼太了漂亮。
s_py: zhè xiē dēng long tài le piào liang
zh: 这些灯笼太漂亮了。
py: zhè xiē dēng long tài piào liang le
en: These lanterns are so pretty.
why: In 太 … 了 the 了 closes the remark after the adjective; it cannot sit between 太 and the adjective.

src_py: tā měi tiān dǎ sǎo fáng jiān
task: Say he spent two hours cleaning the room yesterday.
zh: 他昨天打扫了两个小时的房间。
py: tā zuó tiān dǎ sǎo le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de fáng jiān
en: He spent two hours cleaning the room yesterday.
why: One finished stretch of cleaning takes 了 right after 打扫, before the duration. The habit marker 每天 of the source is dropped.

src: 我们看了一个小时春节晚会。
src_py: wǒ men kàn le yī ge xiǎo shí chūn jié wǎn huì
task: Say we have been watching for an hour and are still watching.
zh: 我们看了一个小时春节晚会了。
py: wǒ men kàn le yī ge xiǎo shí chūn jié wǎn huì le
en: We have been watching the Spring Festival Gala for an hour.
why: Adding a final 了 turns the finished hour into 'so far, still going'. Without it the watching sounds over.

q: 等邻居搬走___，房东就打算把房子重新装修一下。
zh: 等邻居搬走了，房东就打算把房子重新装修一下。
py: děng lín jū bān zǒu le fáng dōng jiù dǎ suàn bǎ fáng zi chóng xīn zhuāng xiū yī xià
en: Once the neighbours have moved out, the landlord plans to redo the flat.
why: 等 … 了 means 'once that is done', so the first clause ends in 了 even though the plan lies in the future. 着, 的 and 过 cannot mean 'once they have left'.

q: 春节到___，大家都回家了。
zh: 春节到了，大家都回家了。
py: chūn jié dào le dà jiā dōu huí jiā le
en: Spring Festival has arrived, and everyone has gone home.
why: 到了 reports that the festival has arrived, a new situation. 着 and 过 do not go with 到 here, and 的 cannot close the clause.

zh: 我搬来这儿三年了。
py: wǒ bān lái zhè r sān nián le
en: It has been three years since I moved here.
why: A stretch of time since an event ends in 了: 三年了. 了 does not go after 搬来 in this meaning.

zh: 他已经不在这个小区住了。
py: tā yǐ jīng bù zài zhè ge xiǎo qū zhù le
en: He doesn't live in this neighbourhood any more.
why: 已经不 … 了 means 'no longer', with 了 at the very end after 住.

q: 我女儿长大了，不想跟我们一起住___。
zh: 我女儿长大了，不想跟我们一起住了。
py: wǒ nǚ ér zhǎng dà le bù xiǎng gēn wǒ men yī qǐ zhù le
en: My daughter has grown up and doesn't want to live with us any more.
why: 长大了 sets up a change, so 不想 … 了 means 'no longer want to'. 着, 过 and 的 cannot carry that meaning.

q: 我们看___烟花再回家，别太早走。
zh: 我们看了烟花再回家，别太早走。
py: wǒ men kàn le yān huā zài huí jiā bié tài zǎo zǒu
en: Let's watch the fireworks first and then go home; don't leave too early.
why: 再 links two steps, and 了 after 看 marks the first as done before the second. 看着烟花 would mean watching while going home.

s: 我们本来想去爬山，可是下雨了，所以不去了。
s_py: wǒ men běn lái xiǎng qù pá shān kě shì xià yǔ le suǒ yǐ bù qù le
zh: 我们本来想去爬山，可是下雨了，所以不去了。
py: wǒ men běn lái xiǎng qù pá shān kě shì xià yǔ le suǒ yǐ bù qù le
en: We wanted to go hiking, but it started raining, so we're not going after all.
why: Correct: both 了 are needed. 下雨了 reports the new rain and 不去了 reports a changed decision.

q: 我还没买___月饼，你想吃什么馅儿的？
zh: 我还没买月饼，你想吃什么馅儿的？
py: wǒ hái méi mǎi yuè bǐng nǐ xiǎng chī shén me xiàn r de
en: I haven't bought any mooncakes yet; what filling would you like?
why: 还没 + verb says it has not happened yet, so no 了 after 买. 买了 would contradict 没.

q: 房东给我们送___一把新钥匙，还说下周来修窗户。
zh: 房东给我们送了一把新钥匙，还说下周来修窗户。
py: fáng dōng gěi wǒ men sòng le yī bǎ xīn yào shi hái shuō xià zhōu lái xiū chuāng hu
en: The landlord gave us a new key and said he would come to fix the window next week.
why: Handing over one new key is a completed act with a counted object, so 了 follows 送. The second clause is a future plan and takes no 了.

q: 我觉得___这个小区环境不错，所以才搬进来。
zh: 我觉得这个小区环境不错，所以才搬进来。
py: wǒ jué de zhè ge xiǎo qū huán jìng bù cuò suǒ yǐ cái bān jìn lái
en: I thought this neighbourhood had a good environment, which is why I moved in.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state of mind, and takes no 了. The move is the finished event, not the thinking.

q: 元宵节的灯笼太漂亮___，我拍了很多照片。
zh: 元宵节的灯笼太漂亮了，我拍了很多照片。
py: yuán xiāo jié de dēng long tài piào liang le wǒ pāi le hěn duō zhào piàn
en: The Lantern Festival lanterns were so beautiful that I took lots of photos.
why: 太漂亮 as an exclamation needs final 了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot close a 太 remark.

zh: 我们已经等了房东半个小时了。
py: wǒ men yǐ jīng děng le fáng dōng bàn ge xiǎo shí le
en: We have already waited half an hour for the landlord.
why: 等 + 了 + person + amount + 了: the first 了 follows the verb and the second closes the 'so far' report; 已经 goes before the verb.

src_py: wǒ men zuó tiān qù le gōng yuán
zh: 我们昨天没去公园。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi qù gōng yuán
en: We didn't go to the park yesterday.
why: 没 replaces 了 in the negative: 没 + verb, never 没去了. 昨天 may precede or follow the subject.

s: 他已经在楼下站了很久了。
s_py: tā yǐ jīng zài lóu xià zhàn le hěn jiǔ le
zh: 他已经在楼下站了很久了。
py: tā yǐ jīng zài lóu xià zhàn le hěn jiǔ le
en: He has been standing downstairs for a long time.
why: Correct: a duration so far takes 了 after the verb and again at the end. The second 了 is not a repeated mistake.

q: 我们搬来这儿已经半年___，可是还不认识对门的邻居。
zh: 我们搬来这儿已经半年了，可是还不认识对门的邻居。
py: wǒ men bān lái zhè r yǐ jīng bàn nián le kě shì hái bù rèn shi duì mén de lín jū
en: We have lived here for half a year already, but still don't know the neighbours across the hall.
why: 已经 plus a stretch of time up to now closes with 了, which also fits the contrast 还不认识. 着 and 的 cannot end it, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

q: 邻居昨天送___我一盒月饼。
zh: 邻居昨天送了我一盒月饼。
py: lín jū zuó tiān sòng le wǒ yī hé yuè bǐng
en: My neighbour gave me a box of mooncakes yesterday.
why: One finished gift with a counted object (一盒月饼): 了 goes right after 送. 着 is ongoing and 会 is future, so neither fits 昨天.

q: 中秋节那天，奶奶一个人吃___五个月饼。
zh: 中秋节那天，奶奶一个人吃了五个月饼。
py: zhōng qiū jié nà tiān nǎi nai yī ge rén chī le wǔ ge yuè bǐng
en: On Mid-Autumn Festival Grandma ate five mooncakes by herself.
why: A specific day and a counted amount make one finished event, so 了 sits right after 吃. 过 would only claim a lifetime experience, which clashes with 那天.

q: 昨天邻居没来___。
zh: 昨天邻居没来。
py: zuó tiān lín jū méi lái
en: The neighbour didn't come yesterday.
why: 没 already says it did not happen, so 来 takes no 了. 没来过 would say the neighbour has never come at all.

zh: 孩子吃了月饼就睡了。
py: hái zi chī le yuè bǐng jiù shuì le
en: The child fell asleep as soon as he had eaten the mooncake.
why: 了 goes right after 吃, before its object 月饼, and a second 了 closes the past sequence after 睡.

q: 小区的电梯修好___，我们不用爬楼梯了。
zh: 小区的电梯修好了，我们不用爬楼梯了。
py: xiǎo qū de diàn tī xiū hǎo le wǒ men bù yòng pá lóu tī le
en: The lift in our block has been fixed, so we don't have to climb the stairs any more.
why: 修好 reports a new situation (the lift works now), and the second clause is its result, so 了 closes the first clause. 的, 着 and 在 do not report a change.

src: 你先打扫厨房，然后做饭。
src_py: nǐ xiān dǎ sǎo chú fáng rán hòu zuò fàn
task: Combine into one sentence with 再.
zh: 你打扫了厨房再做饭。
py: nǐ dǎ sǎo le chú fáng zài zuò fàn
en: Clean the kitchen before you cook.
why: 'Do A, then B' puts 了 right after the first verb 打扫 and 再 before the second; 做饭 takes no 了.
